messages.content:
You are an experienced UK building control surveyor. Answer the question about the work item
in the JSON state. Choose exactly one label:
- not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
- competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
- building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
- full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
Reply with JSON only: {"label": "<one label>", "probabilities": {"<label>": <0..1>, ...}} with a
probability for every label, summing to 1.

Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

{"work_item": "Replace a solid timber back door", "project": "House in England", "jurisdiction": "England. The Building Regulations 2010 as amended.", "clauses": [{"ref": "Sch 3 para 10", "document": "BR2010", "text": "10. Installation, as a replacement, of a window, rooflight, roof window or door in an existing dwelling. | A person registered in respect of that type of work by Assure Certification Limited, ... ... Blue Flame Certification Limited, CERTASS Limited, Certsure LLP, by Fensa Limited under the Fenestration Self-Assessment Scheme or by NAPIT Registration Limited ..., ...."}, {"ref": "Sch 3 para 11", "document": "BR2010", "text": "11. Installation, as a replacement, of a window, rooflight, roof window or door in an existing building other than a dwelling. This paragraph does not apply to glass which is load bearing or structural or which forms part of glazed curtain walling or a revolving door. | A person registered in respect of that type of work by Assure Certification Limited, ... Blue Flame Certification Limited, CERTASS Limited, Certsure LLP, by Fensa Limited under the Fenestration Self-Assessment Scheme or by NAPIT Registration Limited ..., ...."}, {"ref": "para 10.3", "document": "ADL1-2021", "text": "10.3 For new and replacement windows, roof windows, rooflights and doors (controlled fittings), if the entire unit of that fitting is provided, all the following apply. a. Units should be draught-proofed. b. Units should meet the minimum standards given in Table 4.2. c. Insulated cavity closers should be installed where appropriate."}]}

message.reasoning: I'm trying to recall the exact definition of a "controlled fitting" under Part L and whether the 50% glazing threshold applies to distinguishing doors from windows in this context.
